name: MetaBalls-TS-TW
blurb: Liquid-like shapes that orbit and blend, responding to cursor position.
description: WebGL shader-rendered metaballs that flow in circular patterns, blending colors where they touch. Pointer-controlled ball follows the cursor when interactive, otherwise orbits the center.
use_when: Playful, organic-feeling backgrounds or hero sections where a lively liquid effect fits the brand.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, touch-only surfaces, or low-end devices — rendering 50 metaballs is compute-intensive.
a11y: Passive visual effect; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
